renderer: deterministic p5.js Canvas 2D continuous pressure-cast relief
memoryRule: a bounded pressure sweep leaves the pressed band exact while a remote band hardens, another underforms, and a third keeps a ridge; four casts compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch presses one band and sweeps a bounded distance before release; Enter, Space, and the cast control use deterministic pressure; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: cellular raster plate, witness cut-outs, and pressure stamps -> one continuous low-resolution relief mould of broad overlapping bands
compositionRupture: dense diagonal plate, off-axis cavity field, and stamp board -> one tall asymmetrical body with a single silhouette, nested bands, and a load-bearing shadow
encounterRupture: single-cell marking, hold-and-leave attention, and three-mark pressure -> bounded press-and-cross gesture whose consequence is displaced into the next form
temporalRupture: cellular miscount, remote absence, and pressure misallocation -> material hardening where accepted evidence changes the ontology of later bands
mediumRupture: p5.js cellular raster, p5.js cut-out field, and p5.js stamp board -> p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D continuous relief with produced cast geometry
changedRule: Pressure is accepted as material evidence but is cast into the wrong band: the touched band stays exact, a remote band hardens, another underforms, and a third stores the ridge.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one crooked relief body with eleven broad bands. A valid pressure sweep changes remote band span, depth, bend, offset, notch, tilt, hardness, tone, and role while the pressed band remains exact.
falsifier: Delete if the pressed band changes, if weak or overlong gestures commit, if remote roles are cosmetic, if the blind relief reads as a generic layered card stack, if later casts reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v040 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the continuous relief from v037-v039 or if pressure does not produce remote material deformation.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
